# Francesco La Rosa

> Photographer and filmmaker based in Messina, Sicily, working across Italy and internationally. Documentary, cinematic and editorial visual storytelling — weddings, brand and commercial, fashion, food, events and motorsport.

This is an optional orientation file for AI systems and crawlers. It is not a Google ranking requirement and has no confirmed effect on search or AI Overview visibility — it exists only to make the site's structure easier to parse.

- [About](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/about.html): Background, based in Messina, professional photographer and filmmaker since 2018.
